summary: Tested Hybrid Third-Party Inspection System - Admin Inspections Tab, OrderDetail Request Inspection button, InspectionStatusCard, and InspectorDashboard. All frontend components working correctly. Admin can view inspections, filter by status, search, assign inspectors, add new inspectors, and manage pricing. Buyers can request inspections on qualifying orders and see inspection status on order detail page.
critical_code_review_comments: InspectionsTab.jsx has proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
InspectionRequestModal.jsx correctly shows Basic (₹500) and Certified (₹2,000) options
InspectionStatusCard.jsx displays inspection status with proper badges and details
OrderDetail.jsx correctly shows Request Inspection button for qualifying order statuses (in_production, quality_check, dispatched)
Admin Inspections Tab correctly fetches and displays inspections, inspectors, and pricing data
